description: Search the OpenMoov online property auction catalogue: lots with guide price, starting and current bid, bid count, opening/closing times, the property and the lot page url. Returns available:false when auctions are not currently open to the public. Filter by free text (town, postcode, street, property type) and guide-price range; open_only (default true) hides closed lots. A lot that is no longer open or scheduled shows its street and postcode district only (no house number, no full postcode) and no bid figures. Bidding needs an account, ID checks and a deposit hold, so it is never done in conversation — send the user to the lot url. A guide price is not the reserve.

open_only.description: Default true: only lots open or opening for bids

query.description: Town, postcode, street or property type

name: search_auction_lots
title: Search online property auction lots
